surfaces.title: Communication Channels Media
surfaces.reason: Runtime messaging-channel media; no source equivalent.

surfaces.title: Conversations
surfaces.reason: Site inbox runtime communication; WordPress sources have no inbox concept, conversation history is not a migration capability.

surfaces.title: Messages
surfaces.reason: Site inbox runtime communication; see conversations.

surfaces.title: Categories
surfaces.reason: A comments Category is per-resource comment CONFIGURATION (guest commenting, reaction type, marked-comment label, ratings settings, permissions) — the settings a Comments widget runs under, not user content. WordPress carries the analogous knobs as per-post comment_status/ping_status and site discussion options, which are site setup, not migratable records. No source record maps to a Category.

surfaces.title: Moderation Rules
surfaces.reason: Forward-looking moderation POLICY for content submitted after the migration (max 20 rules per namespace, already integrated into Comments and Reviews with no app install). Nothing in a WordPress/WooCommerce source is a moderation rule. It matters to an import only as an environmental effect — rules run against reviews created by Bulk Create Review and can move them to IN_MODERATION or REJECTED — and that interaction is recorded as a pitfall on stores/review, not as an entity here.

surfaces.title: Reports V2
surfaces.reason: Abuse reports filed by site visitors against content ("currently supported for Wix Comments only"). A runtime moderation signal produced by visitors after the fact; WordPress/WooCommerce sources carry no report records, and importing accusations against imported content would be neither faithful nor desirable.

surfaces.title: Review Requests
surfaces.reason: Requests SENT TO customers asking them to review an order or item — an outbound solicitation the site schedules going forward, not a record of past customer feedback. WooCommerce core has no review-request entity (review reminders are plugin territory), so there is nothing to import; and creating requests during a migration would email a store's whole customer history.

surfaces.title: Attachment V4
surfaces.reason: Contact file attachments; no observed source capability. Revisit if a CRM source carrying per-contact files is profiled.

surfaces.title: Bulk Job
surfaces.reason: V4-generation bulk-job machinery; the used bulk path is Contacts V5 bulk upsert (crm/contact).

surfaces.title: Contact V4
surfaces.reason: Superseded contact API generation; crm/contact targets Contacts V5.

surfaces.title: Notes V2
surfaces.reason: Per-contact notes; no observed WP/Woo source capability (order notes live on orders). Revisit if a CRM-notes source is profiled.

surfaces.title: Skills
surfaces.reason: AI-skill documentation page, not a data surface.
